title: 第5章 准备88xiaoshuo net 第6章 黄粱一梦
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
“啪啪啪！”
就在这时，大门外响起了鼓掌声，然后就是脚步声，越来越近，刘磊扭头看向大门外。
“厉害，厉害，不愧是追风盗的老大。”齐源一脸笑容的走进院落中看着刘磊。
刘磊看着出现的齐源一脸震惊，这不是白天那个村外人吗？他就是那个高人？
一直以为这人细皮嫩肉，不像个练武之人，只是背景不简单，没想到居然是个高手！
与此同时刘磊眼睛余光也打量着齐源身后，期待着其他追风盗的身影。
虽然这么久除了齐源，其他一点动静都没有，已经心中有大概的猜测，但还是抱着最后一点希望。
齐源注意到了刘磊的小动作，没说什么，只是把挂在腰间的东西丢给刘磊。
等东西落在刘磊脚下的时候，包裹的布已经掉了，看着脚下既熟悉又陌生的头颅，刘磊心神一颤，双手一松饮血剑剑尖已经触碰到刘磊眉心。
感受着眉心冰冷的剑尖，刘磊赶忙再次用力抓紧了饮血剑，可是眉心还是被划破！
点点血液从眉心涌出，从剑尖被吸收进剑身！
二弟已经死了，其他人也一点动静都没有，此时刘磊已经知道自己必死无疑，但不愿死的莫名其妙。
于是歇斯底里的问道:“为什么？我们好心让你借住一晚，也没有向你动手，为什么要赶尽杀绝！”
齐源一听，也是笑了：“你可真有意思，我以为你屠杀村民的时候，就已经接受有一天被人杀的事实，没想到轮到你被杀的时候，就开始问为什么要赶尽杀绝。”
“你...你是因为那些村民？”
“不，我跟那些村民既不认识，也没有一点关系。”
“那...”
“因为你们让我感觉到危险了！难道我要把自己的命交给你们的好心？指望你们隔天真的让我走？与其被动应对，不如主动出击！”
说到这里的齐源顿了一下，然后接着说道：“而且，我也确实需要原始积累，而你们就是我的原始积累！”
“原始积累？什么原始积累？”刘磊一头雾水，根本不明白这是什么意思。

此时也没时间让刘磊想了，由于大量血液被饮血剑吸收，双手已经渐渐抓不住饮血剑了，可是齐源距离他还有一段距离，就算现在弃剑近身博一线生机，饮血剑也能在他近身前击杀他！
齐源仿佛是看出了刘磊的想法说道：“好了，现在已经知道练肉的实力了，可以送你下去见你二弟了，让你们一家团聚。”
话音刚落，刘磊只感觉眉心跟双手一痛，伤口处更多的血液流出，涌向剑身，被转化成红色雾气缠绕在剑身。
刘磊连惨叫声都没来得及发出，就已经气绝身亡，然后成为一具被吸干气血的干尸！
然后饮血剑重新飞回齐源身边，并且反馈给齐源气血。
“练肉就是不一样，比练皮的气血多的多。”齐源感叹道。
练肉气血就已经这么多了，那练脏或者换血呢！
不过得小心点，练肉境界千斤之力已经可以抓住饮血剑，虽然最后还是死在剑下。
但要是境界更高的，那恐怕就没有那么容易对付了，看来还是要练一练剑法，这样可以把自身的实力最大程度发挥出来。
现在追风盗的人已经都解决好了，可以一个个搜尸了，之前时间紧还没来得及搜尸，现在有的是时间，自然不能放过搜尸这个穿越者传统。
等齐源忙完已经快中午了，追风盗的尸体跟房屋都搜索了一遍，找到不少武器跟银两，武器里面也就刘磊的刀有点看头，但被饮血剑一下就斩断了。
银两的话，其他人身上基本都是碎银，也就刘磊跟刘章两兄弟房屋里面搜出来了银票，加起来有一千多两。
齐源找到的时候也是一愣：“当盗匪这么赚钱吗？”
不过也没管这些银票到底是怎么来的，反正现在是齐源的了。
等整理完战利品，齐源开始收集尸体，齐源自然不是善心大发想要让他们入土为安，而是在为下一个月的奇物抽取做准备。
齐源没打算走，而是要在这个新手村发育一下，虎煞刀法虽然是刀法，但是齐源打算用剑练练看，顺便等下个月奇物抽取。
不少的奇物都是以生灵血肉精华，或者七情六欲、三魂七魄为食。
齐源也不知道下个月奇物抽取会获得什么，所以提前做好准备，要是抽取到需要用到尸体的奇物，到时候也不用到处找。
一个月的时间，已经是干尸的追风盗，不知道还会不会腐烂，齐源不是学医的，不清楚这些，不过也没关系，只是一个准备而已，能用上最好，用不上也不影响。
content_en:
"Bah bang bang!"
At this moment, there was applause outside the gate, and then footsteps, getting closer and closer. Liu Lei turned his head and looked outside the gate.
"Awesome, awesome, worthy of being the boss of the Wind Chasers." Qi Yuan walked into the courtyard and looked at Liu Lei with a smile on his face.
Liu Lei looked shocked when he saw Qi Yuan appearing. Isn't this the outsider from the village during the day? Is he that expert?
I always thought that this person was thin-skinned and tender, not like a martial arts practitioner, but his background was not simple, but I didn't expect that he was actually a master!
At the same time, Liu Lei looked behind Qi Yuan out of the corner of his eyes, looking forward to the figures of other chasing thieves.
Although there has been no movement except for Qi Yuan for so long, I already have a rough guess in my mind, but I still hold on to my last hope.
Qi Yuan noticed Liu Lei's little movement and didn't say anything. He just threw the thing hanging on his waist to Liu Lei.
When the thing fell at Liu Lei's feet, the wrapping cloth had fallen off. Looking at the familiar yet unfamiliar head at his feet, Liu Lei's heart trembled. He let go of his hands and the tip of the blood-drinking sword touched the center of Liu Lei's eyebrows.
Feeling the cold tip of the sword between his eyebrows, Liu Lei quickly grasped the blood-drinking sword tightly again, but his eyebrows were still scratched!
A little bit of blood gushes out from between the eyebrows and is absorbed from the tip of the sword into the sword body!
The second brother was already dead, and there was no movement from the others. At this time, Liu Lei already knew that he was bound to die, but he didn't want to die for no reason.
So he asked hysterically: "Why? We kindly let you stay for one night and didn't attack you. Why do we have to kill them all!"
When Qi Yuan heard this, he also laughed: "You are really interesting. I thought that when you massacred the villagers, you had already accepted the fact that you would be killed one day. I didn't expect that when it was your turn to be killed, you started asking why you wanted to kill them all."
"You...are you because of those villagers?"
"No, I neither know nor have any relationship with those villagers."
"Then..."
"Because you made me feel in danger! Am I going to entrust my life to your kindness? Do I expect you to really let me go the next day? Instead of reacting passively, it's better to take the initiative!"
Qi Yuan paused for a moment before saying this, and then continued: "Besides, I do need primitive accumulation, and you are my primitive accumulation!"
"Primitive accumulation? What primitive accumulation?" Liu Lei was confused and didn't understand what this meant.
At this time, Liu Lei had no time to think about it. Due to the large amount of blood being absorbed by the blood-drinking sword, his hands were gradually unable to hold the blood-drinking sword. However, Qi Yuan was still some distance away from him. Even if he abandoned the sword and got close to gain a chance of survival, the blood-drinking sword could still kill him before he got close!
Qi Yuan seemed to have read Liu Lei's thoughts and said: "Okay, now that you know the strength of meat training, I can send you down to meet your second brother and reunite your family."
As soon as he finished speaking, Liu Lei felt a pain between his eyebrows and his hands. More blood flowed out from the wound and rushed towards the sword body, where it was transformed into red mist and wrapped around the sword body.
Liu Lei died before he could even scream, and then became a mummy with his blood sucked out!
Then the blood-drinking sword flew back to Qi Yuan and fed back Qi Yuan's energy and blood.
"Training meat is different. It produces more energy and blood than training skin." Qi Yuan sighed.
That’s enough for training the flesh, qi and blood, what about training the viscera or exchanging blood!
But you have to be careful. With the strength of a thousand pounds in the meat training realm, you can already catch the blood-drinking sword, although you still die under the sword in the end.
But if you are at a higher level, it may not be so easy to deal with. It seems that you still need to practice swordsmanship, so that you can maximize your strength.
Now that the people chasing the wind thieves have been dealt with, we can search the bodies one by one. Before, we were short of time and didn't have time to search the bodies. Now we have plenty of time, so naturally we can't let go of the time traveler tradition of searching the bodies.
By the time Qi Yuan finished his work, it was almost noon.The Feng Thief's body and house were searched, and a lot of weapons and coins were found. Among the weapons, Liu Lei's knife was the only one that was interesting, but it was cut off by the blood-drinking sword.
As for the silver taels, everyone else was basically covered in broken silver. The banknotes found in the houses of brothers Liu Lei and Liu Zhang amounted to more than a thousand taels in total.
Qi Yuan was also stunned when he found it: "Is it so profitable to be a bandit?"
But it doesn’t matter where these banknotes came from, anyway, they belong to Qi Yuan now.
After sorting out the loot, Qi Yuan began to collect the corpses. Naturally, Qi Yuan was not out of kindness and wanted to let them bury them in peace, but was preparing for the extraction of rare objects next month.
Qi Yuan did not plan to leave, but wanted to develop in this novice village. Although the Hu Sha sword technique was a sword technique, Qi Yuan planned to practice it with a sword and wait for the rare items to be drawn next month.
Many strange objects feed on the essence of flesh and blood, or the seven emotions, six desires, three souls and seven souls.
Qi Yuan doesn't know what he will get in the rare item draw next month, so he is prepared in advance. If he draws a rare item that requires a corpse, he won't have to look for it.
A month later, the corpse of Chai Feng Thief has become a mummy. I don’t know if it will rot. Qi Yuan is not a medical student, so he doesn’t know this, but it doesn’t matter. It’s just a preparation. It’s the best that can be used. It doesn’t matter if it’s not used.
